about: Cases of the ext.system recorder: observations in, the graph out. Each case runs its steps on a new, empty store with the environment it gives. See README.md.

cases.name: a shell session records the machine, its directory, project, profile and selections
observing the same shell again commits nothing
a later shell observation drops the profile and selections it no longer has
a relative directory is taken from the working directory, and the project is the directory without a marker
a web origin is recorded against the shell session
host inventory records shells, filesystems, webviews and permissions
an empty kind removes what was observed of it, an absent kind keeps it
host inventory refuses a shell without an absolute path
processes record the machine's process tree, executables, applications and resources
a complete enumeration removes processes that are gone
process observations refuse a scope other than all or process
adapter inventory records adapters, contexts, programs, installers, resources and aliases
the shell, host, process and adapter projections share one graph
